Resolves #941

Adds configurable `12h` (`am/pm`) and `24h` time formatting (plus custom `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options object support and reactive `locale_` updates) to `Neo.calendar.view.week.TimeAxisComponent`, binds provider-backed `TimeAxisComponent#timeFormat_` and `Neo.calendar.view.settings.WeekContainer` radio controls to `MainContainerStateProvider`'s `timeFormatter` so shared calendar time formatting agrees from initialization onward (while preserving explicit `config.timeFormat` overrides via `beforeSetBind`), and wires `Neo.calendar.view.week.Component#afterSetIntlFormat_time` so rendered week event times re-render reactively when `timeFormatter` updates.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit suite exercising standalone TimeAxisComponent, default-provider WeekComponent + WeekSettingsContainer, direct stateProvider updates, and explicit timeAxisConfig overrides) → L2 required (#941 has no sandbox-unreachable ACs). Residual: none.

No structured ACs on #941

| Default `en-US` provider and `WeekSettingsContainer` radio controls agree from initialization and switch to `24h` without toggle-away workaround | `test/playwright/unit/calendar/TimeAxisComponent.spec.mjs` (`default en-US provider and real WeekSettingsContainer radio controls agree from initialization and switch to 24h without toggle-away workaround`) |
| Provider `locale` / `timeFormat` updates and explicit `timeFormat` standalone-axis override (`beforeSetBind`) | `test/playwright/unit/calendar/TimeAxisComponent.spec.mjs` (`provider updates synchronize WeekSettingsContainer selection, TimeAxisComponent, and WeekComponent events, while explicit timeAxisConfig.timeFormat overrides default binding`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Documented the consumed `timeFormat_` / `locale_` and provider-backed vs. standalone Contract Ledger on `#941` (`#941#issuecomment-6661799877`).
- Normalized `'am/pm'` to `'12h'` in `TimeAxisComponent#beforeSetTimeFormat` while validating string enums against `static timeFormats = ['12h', '24h']` and preserving custom `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options object pass-through (`Neo.isObject(value)`).
- Used `{hour: 'numeric', hour12: true}` in `'12h'` mode for full-hour axis labels (`'12 AM'`..`'11 PM'`) and `{hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false}` (`'00:00'`..`'23:00'`) in `'24h'` mode.
- Bound `TimeAxisComponent#timeFormat` (`data => data.timeFormatter?.resolvedOptions().hour12 ? '12h' : '24h'`, omitted when an explicit `config.timeFormat` override is passed at construction via `beforeSetBind`) and `WeekContainer`'s `timeFormat` `RadioField`s (`bind.checked`) to `MainContainerStateProvider`'s `timeFormatter` so settings selection, axis hour cycle, and event hour cycle share a single authority from initialization onward.
